description: Source code for an example implementation of Alternating Least Squares (ALS) matrix factorization using Spark, demonstrating collaborative filtering for recommendations.

classes.name: LocalALS
classes.description: Object containing methods and parameters for ALS matrix factorization example.

methods.name: generateR
methods.description: Generates a random rating matrix R based on current M, U, F parameters.

methods.name: rmse
methods.description: Calculates Root Mean Square Error between target matrix and estimated ratings.

methods.name: updateMovie
methods.description: Updates the feature vector for a specific movie based on user ratings.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates the feature vector for a specific user based on movie ratings.

methods.name: showWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning that this is a naive implementation of ALS.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for running the ALS example, parsing arguments, initializing data, and performing iterative updates.

methods.name: randomVector
methods.description: Creates a random feature vector of specified size.

methods.name: randomMatrix
methods.description: Creates a random matrix with specified dimensions.
